title: Add GitHub bug and feature request forms
changes: Add a bug report form for ROM region, platform, device or PC specifications, bug description, reproduction steps and optional screenshots, cartridge saves and save-state snapshots.
Add a shorter feature request form and link the issue chooser from the README. Public attachment guidance asks reporters not to share ROM or BIOS files.
validation: Parsed both YAML forms and checked required fields, ROM and platform choices, optional attachment areas, unique field identifiers and existing GitHub labels.
Checked the form and attachment syntax against GitHub documentation and ran git diff --check.
limitations: GitHub only displays the forms after they are added to the repository default branch; browser rendering has not yet been verified.
